children: Shares of six companies are expected to be in focus on Monday, September 21, after the companies announced fresh order wins across sectors including oil and gas, telecom, railways, marine infrastructure, urban water and waste management.
Welspun Corp

Welspun Corp's associate company East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry (EPIC), a listed entity in Saudi Arabia, has signed a contract with Saudi Arabian Oil Co. (Aramco) for the manufacturing and supply of steel pipes.

The contract is valued at more than 771 million Saudi riyals, or approximately ₹2,000 crore, including value-added tax. The contract is to be executed over six months, with the financial impact expected from Q4 FY27 through Q1 FY28.
HEG Advanced
HEG Advanced has secured an order worth ₹218 crore from Indus Towers for the supply of lithium-ion battery banks.
The order has been received by Replus Engitech Private Limited, a subsidiary of HEG Advanced. The contract is scheduled to be executed on or before March 31, 2027.
RVNL
Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd (RVNL) has received a Letter of Award worth ₹405 crore from East Coast Railway.

The order covers the execution of roadbed works, minor and major bridges, road under bridges (RUBs) and limited height subways (LHS), building works, ballast supply, track linking and other allied works. It also includes utility shifting, signalling and telecommunications and electrification works, including power supply arrangements and the shifting or modification of high-tension and low-tension lines.
The work relates to the Khurda Road-Gangadharpur section as part of the third-line project between Nergundi-Barang and Khurda Road-Vizianagaram.
Knowledge Marine
Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works (KMEW) has secured a contract worth approximately ₹279.33 crore, including taxes, from the Mumbai Port Authority.
The order involves the construction and hiring of a battery-operated green tug for a 15-year tenure.

The company said the contract strengthens its presence in the green tug segment. KMEW has now secured three green tug contracts from major ports, expanding its portfolio of marine assets with long-term operating commitments.
Welspun Enterprises
Welspun Enterprises' subsidiary Welspun Municipal Water & Utility Services has received Letters of Award for sewer-line rehabilitation projects in Ahmedabad with a combined value of ₹351.24 crore.

The western Ahmedabad project, worth ₹229.48 crore, involves rehabilitation of the main trunk sewer line from Gola Lake to the 285 MLD tertiary sewage pumping station, covering the stretch from Iskcon Char Rasta to the 285 MLD TSPS.

The eastern Ahmedabad project, valued at ₹121.76 crore, covers the rehabilitation of sewer lines across stretches including Odhav 310 to Panjrapole Char Rasta to Nirant Cross Road to Mahadev Imperial, as well as Metro Pillar No. 99 to Nirant Char Rasta.

The company said the projects are among the largest individual sewer rehabilitation works currently being undertaken by the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation. Following the orders, its order book as of June 2026 increased from around ₹2,135 crore to approximately ₹2,432.66 crore, an addition of around ₹297.66 crore excluding GST and provisional sums.
Refex Industries
Refex Industries has secured a contract worth ₹160 crore from a public sector undertaking in Madhya Pradesh.
The order involves the lifting of 10 lakh metric tonnes of pond ash and fly ash. The contract is to be executed over 18 months.

title: Order Win Impact: These six stocks may react after bagging contracts worth over ₹3,300 crore
